title: Top of the Town

services.name: Corporate Events & Meetings
services.desc: Host your next conference, training, or company celebration in a private, elevated space with panoramic views. We offer flexible booking options, built-in event support, and a streamlined planning process-so your team can focus on the agenda, not logistics. Choose from multiple room sizes and configurations to match your agenda-boardroom sessions, retreats, luncheons, awards dinners, or holiday parties. Enhance the environment with AV support, teleconferencing capabilities, and high-speed internet so your event runs smoothly from start to finish. Top of the Town is a world-class conference facility designed for everything from a meeting for 2 to a presentation for 150 seated or 180
